mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals severe economic distress, triggering aggressive policy responses that reverse equity market declines within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, prompting policy stimulus that reverses equity declines within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 financial crisis recovery regime, federal funds rate declines below 0.25% correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as economic stabilization accelerates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during the post-2008 recovery when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering policy responses that reverse equity market declines within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous real GDP contraction (GDPC1 decline) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signal deflationary risk, prompting aggressive stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 declines and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery, housing starts (HOUST) below 550.0 thousand units signal recovery setbacks, triggering policy responses that reverse equity declines within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 550.0 during housing market recovery.
